fullDescription:
Immerse yourself in the tranquil beauty of a tree farm with our “ChristmasTree Farm” Procreate color palette! This carefully curated collection of rustic and earthy hues captures the essence of a peaceful day at the farm, infusing your digital artwork with the serenity and natural beauty of the outdoors.

Our palette features a captivating range of Christmas tree farm-inspired colors, from deep forest greens and rustic bark browns to fun red hues. Each color is thoughtfully selected to evoke the calm and harmony of a visit to the tree farm, making it the perfect choice for creating artwork that celebrates the simplicity and natural splendor of rural life.

Whether you’re crafting serene landscapes, designing rustic scenes, or simply looking to add a touch of tree farm tranquility to your digital creations, this Procreate color palette is your artistic companion. It empowers you to bring the rustic and earthy colors of a tree farm to your artwork effortlessly.

What’s Included:
A high-quality Procreate color palette .swatches file for easy import into your Procreate app.
